column1: # Culprit signatures for entropy.sh. Tab-separated, one row per culprit; lines starting with # are ignored.
# kind=proc: match is an awk extended regex on the full command line; arg is any | orphan (parent is launchd) | stale (running over 1 day).
# kind=path: match is one or more globs joined by | (~ is expanded, missing paths skipped); arg is the tool's own clean command, `path` (remove the exact listed paths) or `-` (never automatic).
# priority: normal | low (offer last) | ask (inspect with the user first) | expose (rank first, reachable from outside).
# min_age_days (path only): count a match only if nothing inside changed for that many days.
# Add your own rows in a file named by ENTROPY_CULPRITS_EXTRA; same columns, no header.
